# Gyanama: full reference

> Gyanama is a school app for Indian K-12 schools, on Android, iOS and the web. It runs attendance, fees, homework, exams and report cards for principals, teachers, students and families. When a student's monthly attendance keeps falling, Gyanama messages the family in the app and then calls the parent, and logs what the parent said for the class teacher.

This file lists what Gyanama does today, feature by feature. A shorter summary is at https://gyanama.com/llms.txt

## Overview
- Product: Gyanama, a school app and web app for K-12 schools in India.
- Boards: CBSE, ICSE and State Board. Gyanama does not support IB.
- Classes: playgroup, pre-nursery, nursery, LKG and UKG through Class 12.
- Platforms: Android 7.0 or later, iOS 13 or later, and a web app on each school's own address.
- Roles: principal, coordinator, manager, teacher and student. Families sign in with the student's login.
- Language: the app screens are in English. AI calls are in Hindi, Hinglish or English. The family AI chat in the app also handles Marathi and Tamil.
- Company: ARCOS Technologies Private Limited, Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India.
- Website: https://gyanama.com

## Attendance
Page: https://gyanama.com/student-attendance-management
- The class teacher marks daily attendance in the app as Present, Absent, Leave or Half-day.
- Approved leave changes the day to Leave on its own. A gate pass marks the student as Half-day.
- The principal sees live attendance percentages for the school, each class and each section, with a flag on sections that have not been marked yet.
- Attendance is one daily entry per student.
- The monthly register for a section or class downloads as PDF or Excel, in A4 or A3. All sections can be downloaded together as one ZIP file.

## AI attendance calls
Page: https://gyanama.com/voice-agent-for-schools
- Gyanama checks each student's monthly attendance every day.
- Below 60%: the family gets an app message and up to 3 reminders, then a call.
- Below 40%: the call goes out straight away.
- Each school sets its own limits. 60% and 40% are the starting values, so a CBSE school can use 75%.
- Approved leave, weekends and holidays are skipped when attendance is checked.
- Calls run between 10 am and 6 pm and last up to 4 minutes.
- By default a school makes up to 50 calls a day.
- Calls start in Hindi or Hinglish and switch to English when the parent replies in English.
- Numbers on the school's Do Not Call list are never called.
- The call cannot be transferred to a person. When a parent asks for the teacher, a callback is logged for the class teacher.
- Every call is logged against the student with the reason given, its category, how the parent responded, any follow-up needed, planned absences and whether leave was confirmed.
- AI calls are not part of the Assist plan.

## Fees
Page: https://gyanama.com/fee-management-system
- Fee management runs on the web app and is used by school staff.
- The office sets up fee structures and terms, raises invoices, adds one-off charges, and gives flat or percentage discounts.
- Staff record cash, cheque and UPI payments. Every payment gets a numbered PDF receipt.
- The office prints bulk fee slips for a class and sees a dashboard of fees collected and due.
- A school can connect its own Razorpay account.
- Families can pay online in the app.
- Fee reminder call: Gyanama calls the family 1 day after the due date, between 10 am and 6 pm, for up to 3 minutes, in Hindi, Hinglish or English.
- The fee call only reminds. It never takes payments, quotes amounts or sends links.
- AI fee reminder calls are not part of the Assist plan.

## Exams and report cards
Page: https://gyanama.com/report-card-generator
- The school publishes an exam schedule with the date, time and maximum marks for each subject, and a schedule PDF.
- Teachers upload marks. Every mark is graded on the A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, C2, D and E scale.
- Report card PDFs are made for one student, a whole class, or every student in the school as a ZIP file.
- Report cards come in term and session-cumulative versions, on the school's own template and logo.
- The exam timetable prints from the web app.
- Transfer certificates are numbered PDFs, with dates also written in words, made on the web app.

## Homework and doubts
Page: https://gyanama.com/homework-app
- A teacher sets homework with a deadline and attachments.
- Students submit files and a note from the app. Each upload takes up to 10 files of up to 50 MB each.
- The teacher sees who submitted and who opened the homework.
- Homework submissions are not graded in the app.
- Students ask doubts by subject. Teachers reply with text and attachments.

## Communication, PTMs and forms
Page: https://gyanama.com/parent-teacher-communication
- Announcements go to the whole school or to selected classes, with attachments and a push notification.
- Teachers and students or families chat one to one in the Android and iOS app, with attachments and search.
- PTM: a family requests a date and time, and the teacher accepts or declines the request.
- Forms have 8 field types, go to selected classes, close on a deadline and show a summary of responses.
- The school calendar is in the app.
- Students request leave in the app. The class teacher approves or rejects it. Leave still pending at 1 am is rejected automatically.
- A gate pass records the parent's name and the exit time.
- Students can report bullying to the principal, who resolves the report.

## Student Progress Score
Page: https://gyanama.com/at-risk-student-detection
- The app shows it as Health Score. The website calls it the Student Progress Score.
- Gyanama computes it every night for every student and class.
- Weights: attendance 35%, academics 30%, homework 20%, behaviour 15%.
- Each score comes with the reasons behind it.
- Bands: Good at 75 and above, Watch at 60 and above, At risk at 45 and above.
- Gyanama also projects each student's final percentage and grade.
- Teachers get a list of students at risk and a weekly digest.

## Test papers
Page: https://gyanama.com/ai-assignment-generator
- The source is the school's own textbook PDF or a book from the NCERT library.
- The teacher picks 1 to 5 chapters.
- Question types: MCQ, true or false, fill in the blank, short answer and long answer.
- The teacher sets the difficulty and Bloom's levels, in English or Hindi.
- Gyanama produces a question paper PDF and an answer key.
- The teacher can edit every question before the paper is used.

## Timetable
Page: https://gyanama.com/ai-timetable-generator
- Class-wise timetables run from Monday to Saturday.
- Gyanama detects teacher clashes.
- Timetables import and export as Excel files.
- The AI draft follows rules the school writes in plain text, up to 2000 characters. The school reviews the draft before saving.
- The AI timetable draft is not part of the Assist plan.

## AI assistant
- Students, teachers and school admins can ask an AI assistant questions in the app and on the web. It answers from the school's own data.
- The family AI chat in the app handles Hindi, English, Hinglish, Marathi and Tamil.

## Apps and platforms
Pages: https://gyanama.com/school-app and https://gyanama.com/school-web-app
- Android app: Android 7.0 or later. https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.arcostechnologies.gyanama
- iOS app: iOS 13 or later. https://apps.apple.com/in/app/gyanama/id6793635852
- The app has push notifications, dark mode and guided tours, and saves files to the phone's Downloads.
- Sign in uses the phone number and a one-time code. The code expires in 5 minutes and allows 3 tries.
- Several accounts can be added on one phone, for example when two children study in the same school.
- Each school has its own web address, such as yourschool.gyanama.in, with the school's name and logo.
- Web-only work: fee management, attendance register exports, report cards, transfer certificates and exam timetable printing.
- The Gyanama team imports a school's students, staff and classes from Excel sheets.

## Roles
Pages: https://gyanama.com/for-principals, https://gyanama.com/for-teachers and https://gyanama.com/for-parents
- Principal: today's attendance for the school, absentee call logs, the Student Progress Score, exams, gate passes, forms and the calendar.
- Coordinator and manager: their own access to school administration.
- Teacher: attendance, homework, marks, doubts, PTM requests, leave approvals, test papers and the timetable.
- Student: classes, homework submission, exam dates and results, doubts, leave and gate pass requests.
- Family: uses the student's login in the same app and receives the school's AI calls.

## Security
Page: https://gyanama.com/security
- Servers are in India.
- The database is backed up 3 times a day.
- Sign in uses a one-time code sent to the phone.
- There are 5 roles, and each role sees only its own data.
- Every request is logged in an audit log.
- The web server uses security headers, CSRF protection and rate limits.
- The school decides which numbers are never called.

## Boards
Pages: https://gyanama.com/boards and https://gyanama.com/cbse-school-software
- Attendance, AI calls, fees, homework, exams, report cards and the Student Progress Score work the same way for CBSE, ICSE and State Board schools.
- CBSE schools also get the A1 to E grade scale and the NCERT library for test papers.
- ICSE and State Board schools make test papers from their own textbook PDFs.

## Plans
Page: https://gyanama.com/plans
- Gyanama has three plans: Assist, Automate and Autonomy.
- Assist is the school app: attendance, fees, homework, exams, report cards, communication and the timetable on Android, iOS and the web.
- Automate adds the AI features: AI attendance calls, AI fee reminder calls, the Student Progress Score with a projected result, test papers, the AI assistant and the AI timetable draft. It includes 3,000 AI calls a year and a semi white-label app.
- Autonomy adds a full white-label app (the school's own name, logo, colours, splash screen, App Store and Play Store listing, domain and email branding), 5,000 AI calls a year, a dedicated developer and AI engineer, priority infrastructure and an uptime guarantee backed by an SLA.
- Talk to the Gyanama team for pricing: https://gyanama.com/contact-us
